title: Room-temperature synthesis of silver-based nanoparticle-embedded hydrogel material via catalytic crosslinking for recyclable dye degradation applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34068-34078
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03595C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Damini Jagankar, Nikita Das, Amitava Mukherjee, Chandan Maity
A hydrazone-based alginate hydrogel prepared at room temperature via acid catalysis enables in situ formation of Ag-based NPs, achieving >95% dye degradation in 5 minutes with excellent reusability, offering a green solution for remediation.
